mostWorthwhile.text: Making the hydrothermal vent was most worthwhile: the explanation connected circulating seawater, heated rock and chemical energy.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the trench was less satisfying because it did not visibly advance either goal, though its subduction explanation was clear.

surprise.text: I expected the water and moving plates to lead toward a hot spring, but they produced a subduction trench instead.

arbitrary.text: Moving plates plus water felt somewhat arbitrary as a way to select a trench; the result explained how trenches form, but the pairing did not clearly suggest subduction beforehand.

continue.text: Yes. The links between plate motion, weathering and mineral transport made me curious about what the world might make next, even if the offered combinations reduced the challenge of discovery.
